scientific_integrity: Two separately coded finite functional-graph classifiers and exact outputs can be reproduced from the included standalone C++17 sources using replay.py; the present review is same-model only.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive computation on one specified 15-vertex graph for four contact thresholds; no general graph-family theorem, and historical priority against unindexed computations is not certified. Independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Complete excitation and extinction censuses on the Petersen line graph
